integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions; projectivity gives ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A one-parameter subgroup with binary-separated coordinate weights has exactly the coordinate dual tensors as fixed points, and every such coordinate hyperplane is tangent to the Segre variety at an explicit point with two kernel factors.
integrity.object_basis: The inspected full text defines the Segre embedding, its tangent spaces, projective duals, and the hypersurface criterion for Segre dual varieties.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: arXiv:1301.0472 lists MSC 14N05 first and is classified as Algebraic Geometry.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for at least three factors; the two-factor dual is the previously understood generic determinantal case.
Euler characteristic does not determine finer homology, singularities, or complement topology.
The localization proof is short, so an older unindexed equivariant observation may exist.
title: Every higher Segre dual has ambient Euler characteristic
